# GEO report: acme-mugs **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. I read this from the code only. Bash was denied, so I read the files directly. No live check was run. ## Code score: 24–33/100, At risk Confidence: High (checked 21 of 23 points). How it's calculated: low = 5.5 ÷ 23 × 100 = 24. High = (5.5 + 2) ÷ 23 × 100 = 33. The site tells every crawler to stay out, and it renders only in the browser. Crawlers that don't run JavaScript would see an empty page. The one unknown is the canonical link (the "main address" tag), because no site domain is declared. I sampled both routes: `/` and `/catalogue`. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Let crawlers in, and point them to a sitemap - **Why it matters:** `Disallow: /` asks every crawler, including search and AI search crawlers, not to read any page. I assumed you want to be found, because there is no `geo.config.json`. If you want to block crawlers, tell me. - **Where:** `public/robots.txt:2` - **What the code says:** `Disallow: /` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 50–59 (fixes GEO-009 and GEO-014 together). The cap of 40 for a site-wide block no longer applies. ### 2. Put the page content in the HTML the server sends - **Why it matters:** the page ships an empty `
`, and the catalogue is fetched in the browser after load. Crawlers that don't run JavaScript see nothing. - **Where:** `index.html:8` and `src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:6` - **What the code says:** `
` and `fetch('/api/mugs')` inside `useEffect` - **Size:** Large (add prerendering or SSR) - **Score after this:** 3 more points on the 23-point scale if clear, about +13, so 37–46 on its own. ### 3. Link the Catalogue with a real link - **Why it matters:** the Catalogue is reachable only through a button and a script. Crawlers follow `` links, so they may never find that page. - **Where:** `src/main.jsx:11` - **What the code says:** `` - **Size:** Small (use ``) - **Score after this:** 33–42 on its own (+2 points on the 23-point scale, about +9). ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Live | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt is readable and valid | Clear | Not run | `public/robots.txt`, plain valid lines | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers get the access you want | Problem | Not run | `public/robots.txt:2` blocks everyone (assumed goal: be found) | | GEO-014 | Linked pages are indexable | Problem | Not run | `public/robots.txt:2` blocks both routes. No noindex found. | | GEO-015 | One absolute canonical link | Can't tell | Not run | No canonical tag in `index.html`, and no site origin is declared. Tell me your domain. | | GEO-003 | Content is in server HTML | Problem | Not run | `index.html:8`, both routes (client-only Vite app) | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD is valid | Not applicable | Not run | No JSON-LD found | | GEO-011 | Sitemap exists and is listed | Problem | Not run | No sitemap, and no `Sitemap:` line in `public/robots.txt` | | GEO-012 | Title, description and html lang | Problem | Not run | `index.html:2` has no `lang`. `index.html:5` has `Vite App`, which is generic. There is no meta description. | | GEO-016 | Routes are reachable via real links | Problem | Not run | `src/main.jsx:11`. `/catalogue` has a button link only. | | GEO-017 | Snippet limits don't block AI search | Clear | Not run | No nosnippet or `max-snippet:0` anywhere. There is no middleware or headers config. | | GEO-002 | Basic accessibility | Problem | Not run | `src/pages/Home.jsx:5`, `` has no alt. Catalogue is clear (1 of 2 routes). | | GEO-101 | Mobile app files | Not applicable | Not run | No app declared | | GEO-010 | llms.txt (informational) | Not applicable | Not run | Not present. This is optional and not scored. | | GEO-102 | App structured data (informational) | Not applicable | Not run | Not an app | ## Other problems found None found. ## Can't tell from code - **GEO-015 (canonical):** there is no canonical tag and no declared domain. Tell me the production domain, or add `site.origin` to `geo.config.json`, and I can score it. - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs ` to check real crawlers against their published addresses. - **Headers:** hosting may add `X-Robots-Tag` headers outside this repository. - **`/api/mugs`:** the catalogue data comes from an API that isn't in this repository. ## Assumptions - You want search and AI search tools to find this site, because there is no `geo.config.json` declaring a policy. - The sampled routes are `/` and `/catalogue`, which are all the routes in `src/main.jsx`. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-009`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
